410238.title: Stone Temple Pilots

410360.title: Parade Leader

410380.title: Spiritual Comfort

410381.title: Wasn't This Fruit Forbidden?

410382.title: Will You Cast The First Stone?
410382.description: Acquire the fourth Water Guardian reward.

410383.description: Acquire the fifth Water Guardian reward.
